summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (placed before ConjunctiveGraph, with docstring, nested add_to_cbd helper covering rules 1-3) and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (testCbd, testCbdReified, testCbdIncomingReification, testCbdReifierBlankNodeObjectNotExpanded, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testCbdImmutability). Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were verified by reading only. Reifier triple counts were interpreted as five triples per reifier including rdf:subject, which yields 8 and 13 for R5 and R6. Nothing was committed.
